sentences.en: This novel of his is inferior to the previous one.
sentences.zh: 他的这本小说比上一本差。

sentences.en: I would like to, but I have a previous appointment.
sentences.zh: 我想答应你，但我已经有别的安排了。

sentences.en: I'm sorry, but I have a previous appointment for tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 对不起，我明天已经另有安排了。

senses.zh: 以前的，先前的；（时间或顺序上）稍前的；<非正式>过早的，过急的
